checks.name: future_rainfall_leakage
checks.detail: Adding 100 mm at the final step of a 6000-step slice changed no earlier feature value (max delta 0.00e+00 over 54 channels).

checks.name: future_alert_leakage
checks.detail: Alert-derived static features ['alert_count_log', 'alerts_per_year'] reproduce exactly from training-period alerts only (alerts before 2024-01-16 16:45:00+08:00, max delta 0.00e+00); they carry no post-cutoff information.

checks.name: label_horizon_causality
checks.detail: Positives refer to alerts starting 6-12 steps (30-60 min) after the sample, so no label overlaps its own input window.

checks.name: temporal_split_order
checks.detail: Chronological: train ends at step 109640, validation spans 109689-132579, test starts at 132628. No shuffling.

checks.name: split_embargo
checks.detail: Embargo of 48 steps (= sequence 36 + horizon 12) applied; observed gaps are 49 steps before validation and 49 before test, so no training input window overlaps an evaluation sample.

checks.name: split_disjoint
checks.detail: No (step, station) sample appears in more than one split (279,367 train / 728,093 val / 730,072 test).

checks.name: duplicate_events_across_splits
checks.detail: Every labelled flood event falls entirely within one split; the embargo keeps events from straddling a boundary.

checks.name: scaler_fit_region
checks.detail: Scaler reproduces exactly from steps [2592, 109641) and differs from whole-record statistics by up to 0.2100, confirming it never saw validation or test.

checks.name: warmup_respected
checks.detail: First sample at step 2592 >= warm-up 2592 (2592 steps of window fill, 36 steps of sequence).

checks.name: evaluation_split_integrity
checks.detail: Validation holds 728,093 of 728,093 eligible samples and test 730,072 of 730,072: neither is subsampled, so precision reflects the true base rate. Negative subsampling applies to training only (279,367 kept of 3,405,000).

checks.name: station_overlap
checks.detail: All 32 stations appear in every split, which is intended: the task is forecasting forward in time at known stations, not generalising to unseen ones. The split is purely temporal. A model intended for new, ungauged locations would need a station-wise split as well, and would score worse.

checks.name: feature_selection_on_test
checks.detail: No data-driven feature selection is performed: all 54 dynamic and 9 static channels are fixed in FeatureConfig before any data is read, so no split can influence which features exist.

checks.name: threshold_selected_on_validation
checks.detail: Threshold 0.22331822934759205 chosen on validation by max_event_recall_within_accuracy_band; frozen before the test split was read.
